answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each identity to a live location trail: every epoch the network broadcasts a secret code readable only by a device physically at a rotating beacon site. Influence accrues along an unbroken vine of consecutive proofs, and any missed waypoint drops you into the sable dark at zero weight. One operator cannot wander to many dispersed sites at the same instant, so a clone swarm cannot each hold its own distinct live trail, and the fakes collapse into a single admitted identity.
